tweet.text: We’ve previously shared clear examples of models trying to manipulate our evaluations. To detect such behavior, we’ve been using LLM-based monitoring systems, but we lacked a ground truth dataset to validate how these monitors perform. To close this gap, we built MALT.

quote.text: At METR, we’ve seen increasingly sophisticated examples of “reward hacking” on our tasks: models trying to subvert or exploit the environment or scoring code to obtain a higher score. In a new post, we discuss this phenomenon and share some especially crafty instances we’ve seen.
